name: Monster Hunter
body:
You are adept at tracking and slaying your quarry.

Prerequisite(s): Order of the Wolf

Benefit: You gain a +2 feat bonus to Perception and Survival checks to find the creature for which you are questing, and a +1 feat bonus to damage rolls when fighting it. In addition, Knowledge (nature) and Knowledge (arcana) are class skills for you.
